insights: **Weekly Highlights —** CaddyO delivered $1,858 in total sales for Week 45, up 22.4% from $1,518 the prior week, on 66 units. Organic sales grew 192.1% to $569, led by the Blue Wrapsulator at $518 (+82.6%) and a strong lift from the Dual Travel Tote at $134 (+217.6%). Wednesday, Nov 4 was the peak day at $301.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Black Wrapsulator eased to $185 (-29.6%) as its CVR slipped to 5.7% even though sessions rose 20.8%. We are watching its conversion closely and will support it with tighter ad targeting so it can return to its prior velocity alongside the rest of the Wrapsulator line.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend rose to $1,882 from $692, generating $1,288 in PPC revenue for a 0.68x ROAS and 146.1% ACOS, with TACoS at 101.3%. Ad CTR is 0.27% with a 2.58% ad conversion rate, so our priority this week is bringing spend back in line with returns while protecting the organic gains.

**Actions This Week —** We will reduce bids on high-ACOS targets and pull budget back toward the prior $692 level, concentrating spend on proven converters like the Blue Wrapsulator (8.0% CVR) and the Slim Can Cooler (10.0% CVR). We will also test new Sponsored Product and Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.27%.
